title: Nozomi supplement amounts used by the golden-route calculator
content: For adult JAPAN RAIL PASS holders, the official special-ticket table lists ¥4,960 for Tokyo↔Kyoto and ¥4,170 for Shin-Osaka↔Hiroshima. The matrix shows no sale value for Kyoto↔Shin-Osaka, so the current calculator must not invent a supplement for that short pair.
